bagPolicy.summary: Only small clutches, wristlets, or fanny packs no bigger than 6”x 9” and clear plastic bags no bigger than 12"x12"x6” are allowed. All bags are subject to search upon entry.
allowed: clear plastic bags no bigger than 12"x12"x6”
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking lots open 30 minutes before gate time. Premier Parking and Easy Out Parking are available for easier entry and exit. Arrive early to secure your spot.

rideshare.note: For rideshares, go to Palm Lane on the southwest side of the venue.

concessions.note: Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre offers a variety of food and drink options, including Mosh Burger's hormone-free beef burgers, Rebel Hen's crispy chicken tenders, and Ziggy's Magic Pizza Party's NY-inspired pizza. Guests can also enjoy Koko's Bavarian sausages and pretzels, as well as CVT Premium Soft Serve Ice Cream.
stands: CVT Premium Soft Serve Ice Cream

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible Parking is located inside Gate 3 & Gate 6 off of Encanto Blvd.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted at Talking Stick Resort Amphitheatre.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The West Box Office opens at noon, the East Box Office opens about an hour prior to doors.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The two main entry gates are West Gate and East Gate, and each has an accessibility gate open to any ticket type. Fast Lanes at both entrances require a Fast Lane pass, and VIP Lounge guests use a separate gate next to the East Box Office. Some shows open only one gate, so check the Know Before You Go page.
